title: eval-harness: add CI hooks for prompt-set regression gating and metrics reporting
author: Jordan Blake
description:
Motivation: We need deterministic prompt-set regression checks and standardized metric reporting in PRs to catch regressions before merges. This PR adds a lightweight CI hook and GitHub Action that runs the eval-harness on a configurable set of prompt-sets and reports a concise metrics summary back to the PR as a status/check and comment. Key goals: 1) provide fast, incremental gating on prompt/behavior regressions for changed models or prompts; 2) produce artifactized detailed metrics (per-prompt accuracy, BLEU/ROUGE-like scores for structured tasks, embedding-similarity baselines) for downstream triage; 3) avoid costly full evaluations by caching dataset results and supporting an opt-out for docs-only changes.

What this change does: - Adds .github/workflows/eval-harness-ci.yml GitHub Action that invokes eval-harness with --ci-mode and a configured prompt-set list. The workflow supports matrix runs for multiple model variants and a "quick" mode that uses a shortened evaluation subset for pre-merge gating. - Adds tooling in tools/eval/ci_runner.py (small wrapper) to normalize outputs, upload artifacts to the CI artifact store, and post a summarized comment/check to the PR with pass/fail and top-regression examples. - Adds config file .eval-ci.yaml (repo-level opt-in) to select prompt-sets, thresholds, and whether to run full vs quick mode. - Integrates with existing metrics backend by writing a JSON artifact to artifacts/eval-metrics/<pr-number>/metrics.json and publishing a summary to the PR. - Adds gating logic: if any configured metric crosses the regression threshold for the target model variant, the CI check fails and the comment includes top 3 regressions and links to artifacts.

Testing and rollout: - Local unit tests and mock CI runs were added under tests/eval/ to validate output formatting and threshold logic. - The Action was tested on the eval-harness repo with matrix runs for small & medium sample prompt-sets. - Migration plan: repo owners must add .eval-ci.yaml to enable gating; if absent, the workflow runs only a non-blocking summary check. - Performance: quick-mode completes in under ~3 minutes for the common prompt-subset; full-mode varies by model but artifacts & caching reduce repeated work.

Notes: - This PR intentionally keeps the default thresholds conservative to avoid false positives; follow-up work will add automated threshold tuning and a historical baseline service. - See Linear ENG-5123 for implementation plan and ENG-5201 for rollout tracking.
commits_summary: Initial scaffold: add GitHub Action workflow and CI runner wrapper (tools/eval/ci_runner.py)
Add .eval-ci.yaml example, tests for threshold logic, and artifact upload logic
Tweak summary formatting and add matrix support for model variants; update docs and release notes
review_comments: Aisha Patel: Overall looks good. Two asks: (1) can we gate only when model code or prompt-sets change to avoid noise? (2) please ensure sensitive artifacts are not uploaded to public stores.
Jordan Blake: Implemented opt-in config and docs-only fast-skip; artifacts are uploaded to the private CI artifact store by default. See tools/eval/ci_runner.py for the store client.
Miguel Santos: Can you add a small sample of the PR summary format in the tests so reviewers know what they'll see?
Jordan Blake: Added tests/eval/test_ci_runner.py with a snapshot of the summary and top-3 regression sample formatting.
Evan Chen: lgtm after small nit on logging verbosity in ci_runner (reduced INFO noise).
Jordan Blake: Addressed logging nit and squashed commits per request.
release_notes: - Add CI GitHub Action to run eval-harness prompt-set regressions and publish metric artifacts; - Introduce .eval-ci.yaml opt-in config for repo-specific gating rules; - Add tools/eval/ci_runner.py to normalize outputs and post PR summaries; - Conservative default thresholds, quick-mode for fast pre-merge checks
manual_testing_notes: Ran workflow on a fork and on redwood/eval-harness with model-matrix: small/quick and medium/full; validated PR comment formatting, artifact uploads, and gating behavior. Observed quick-mode <3m and full-mode ~12-18m on CI GPU runners.
migration_instructions: Repos must opt into gating by adding .eval-ci.yaml to repo root. If absent, only non-blocking summaries are posted. For Dedicated/private repos, configure artifact_store: private in .eval-ci.yaml.
